title: Oversight: -andó/-endő and szorul
grammar: Duties and Needs in Audit Reports
goal: I can say that something is still to be done with *-andó/-endő* (*tisztázandó*).
I can say that something needs a remedy with *szorul* (*kivizsgálásra szorul*).
I can name the main terms of oversight (*számvevőszék, közérdekű adat, visszaélés*).
